Document.name: TekSavvy Maintenance and Outage Tracker
Document.description:
Areas identified as having future maintenance and current outages.

Please note that as TekSavvy deals with multiple vendors and has limited visibility into their networks. As such, we are not always able to provide an ETR (estimated time of repair) and may not have much detail on the specifics of these outages and maintenance events. Any information we do receive will be posted here.

Still experiencing issues after an outage has been confirmed as being resolved?

If you are still experiencing issues after a previously reported outage has been resolved, please unplug your equipment for 15 minutes and then plug it back in.

If your area is not listed or powering your modem and router off and on does not fix your issue, we will need to troubleshoot with you to fix any problems. Please feel free to call in 24/7 at 1-877-779-1575.
